title: Slotzilla zipline - I'M FLYING souvenir
notes: Derived from briefs/slotzilla_flight_brief.md. Style reference: assets/style_refs/slotzilla_style_01.png (neon 2D cartoon, no studio names). The SLOTZILLA sign is the client's own attraction; confirm with the client that it may appear on merchandise.
style_description: bold-outline 2D cartoon illustration with cel shading, expressive faces with big eyes, saturated neon purple, pink and gold night palette, clean lines suitable for merchandise
character_style_description: bold black ink outlines of varying weight, cel shading with two or three flat tones, slightly exaggerated caricature proportions, big round expressive eyes with white highlights, defined eyebrows, wide open-mouth grin, large expressive hands, hair as chunky flowing strands with highlights, clothes in flat colors with simple folds
plate_prompt: A night scene in the illustration style of image 1, seen from high above a glowing pedestrian street in downtown Las Vegas. On the upper left stands a tall zipline launch tower with a glowing neon SLOTZILLA sign and lucky 777 lights. Far below, a long LED canopy streaks with purple, pink and gold light, with vintage neon signs and small palm trees for scale. A large neon sign reads 'Las Vegas 2026'. Empty zipline cables run from the upper left to the lower right across an open night sky. Portrait 3:4.

pose_arms.prone_superman: arms stretched forward like a superhero
pose_arms.prone_celebrate: arms raised in a triumphant cheer
pose_arms.prone_point: one arm stretched forward and the other pointing to the side

expression_variants: Eyes squeezed shut with a huge joyful laugh

templates.pose: Show exactly one person: the person from image 1, lying horizontally in a zipline harness, flying face down and forward. Image 2 is only a pose diagram; copy its body position: {arms}, legs extended behind with knees slightly bent. Keep the same face, {clothing}, and {hair}, now swept back by the wind. {accessories} Plain light background.
templates.stylize: Redraw the person from image 1 as a full-body cartoon character in this style: {character_style}. Take only colors and lighting from image 2. Show exactly one person: the person from image 1, with the same face, {clothing}, and {hair}, in the same flying pose. {expression}. Plain light background.
templates.harmonize: Blend the riders into the neon night scene: match their lighting and colors to the scene, add soft pink and gold rim light from the signs below, and make each harness hang naturally from its own cable. The image shows exactly {riders}, the only {people} in the picture; keep every rider's face, pose and clothing the same.
templates.effects: Add cinematic speed: speed lines and wind streaks trailing from hands and feet, rippling clothing, and motion blur on the background lights. The image shows exactly {riders}, the only {people} in the picture; keep them and their faces sharp and the same.
templates.pose_check_question: Is the person lying horizontally, face down and forward, in a flying pose?

checklist: Is every person lying horizontally in a flying pose, face down and forward?
Does each person hang from a separate, clearly visible zipline cable?
Is the scene high above a glowing city street at night?
Are all faces sharp and in focus?
Is every person complete, with exactly one head, two arms and two legs?
